loading.title: Preparing your Exchange workspace
loading.body: Your organization and locality are loading. Your setup progress is saved.

empty.title: Your organization is not ready to display here yet
empty.body: Review your organization, location, profile, or marker setup to finish preparing the workspace.

error.title: The workspace could not be prepared
error.body: Your organization and location information were not changed. Retry or return to setup if you need to correct something.

permission.title: This organization workspace is not available to your account
permission.body: Access depends on your current organization membership. Private organization details are not shown.

expired.title: Your workspace session has expired
expired.body: Sign in again to return to the organization workspace available to your account.

recovery.title: Workspace recovery is available
recovery.body: Your organization is still saved. Return to setup to repair the missing information without creating a duplicate organization.

search.lowDensity: Only organizations available in your current Exchange view are shown.
search.noResultsBody: Try a broader capability or remove the service-area filter.

match.disclaimer: Matching explains profile overlap. It is not qualification, endorsement, or guaranteed eligibility.

home.projectionMetadata: Shown from your current organization workspace.
home.viewportBody: Your organization home view is restored when you return.
home.scopeBody: Explore organizations, capabilities, geography, and the Exchange tools currently available to your account. Unavailable actions are identified where they appear.

detail.noServiceAreas: No public service areas are listed.
detail.capabilityEvidence: What this organization says it can do
detail.profileEvidence: Organization profile and capability information is provided by the organization unless it is specifically identified as verified. Discovery does not certify capability, performance, or eligibility.

actionReasons.self-only: Only members of this organization can manage its profile.
actionReasons.not-an-official-provider: This organization has no published Resource Provider services.
actionReasons.exchange-action-unavailable: This action is not available yet. You can continue exploring the Exchange.
